column1: # /Graph F10 view — Legends render below the plot.
# Slice F2 of GRAPH_PLAN.md. The F10 unicode renderer reserves one
# row below the plot (above any X-Axis title) listing every
# populated legend slot in `A: name  B: name  …` form. Empty slots
# are skipped. When no legend is set, no row is reserved.
# Default: no legends → "Sales" should not appear yet.
# Setting the C legend without populating the C series still surfaces
# its label (the row shows whatever the user explicitly set).
